title: Sphere
description: One sphere: a venture (anything a builder undertakes, from a hobby to a company) or a client inside one. Each sphere keeps a sphere.json at its root, beside its human-readable profile (EE-008). Personal life is out of scope (EE-009). Cross-sphere rules are checked by schema/check-spheres.mjs.

kind.description: venture: anything you undertake, at a stage from hobby to company; ventures can hold ventures (a brand house and its lines). client: work for one client, only inside the venture that serves it.

parent.description: The id of the sphere that holds this one. null for a top-level venture; a client always has one.

stage.description: Ventures only. hobby: done for its own sake. venture: an undertaking with risk and intent, not yet a formed company. company: formalized and operating continuously, with a legal_form. A venture changes stage without moving folders (EE-004).

legal_form.description: Ventures at the company stage: the legal and tax structure.

owner.description: self: the builder owns it. shared: owned with others (co-founders, a client contract). other: someone else owns it.

members.description: Roles of the others in it (partner, co-founder, client, manager), not personal details

governed_by.description: Whose rules apply: you, a shared agreement, the employer's policies, a contract, the group's bylaws

layers.description: Every sphere has the same layers, at the depth it needs. A layer it does not use yet is false; one it uses gives where its records live.

links.description: What crosses from this sphere into another, one way: shares-with sends the listed things; reads can see into the other.

access.description: reads: this sphere can see into the other. shares-with: this sphere sends the listed things to the other.

carries.description: What crosses: schedule, availability, finances summary, skills, notes

profile.description: Path to the sphere's human-readable profile (Markdown), which holds its narrative, pillars and changelog

location.description: Path or URL where this layer's records live
